summary: One church, Holy Family, Nutley. Weekend (Sat 5:30 PM; Sun 8, 10, 12), daily 8:45 AM Mon-Sat and Saturday 1 PM Confession agree in both bulletins (Nov 8 and Nov 15) and the website; plus the Nov 26 Thanksgiving Mass. Open: the DST-only Saturday 7 PM Italian Mass (leaning out), the 8:30 PM Neo-Catechumenate liturgy (leaning out), and two website-backed Adoration slots (First Friday 2-7 PM, third-Saturday Holy Hour) whose Mother Cabrini Chapel location is unconfirmed (leaning in). Advent/Lent 7 AM chapel Masses are excluded under R33.

slots.rationale: R33: DST runs from the second Sunday of March to the first Sunday of November, dates that move each year, so a fixed season would be a false pattern. DST ended November 1 and the newest bulletin's intentions list no 7 PM Mass on November 14 or 21, so it is not held now. Leaning leave out: update mode will see it when the bulletins list it again in spring. The 7 PM Mass on November 7 was a one-off Italian Mass with the Archbishop of Campobasso (ba76b6f7 p2), before as_of.
slots.question: Add the Saturday 7:00 PM Italian Mass, which the box says is held only during Daylight Saving Time?

slots.rationale: R30: printed in the Masses box of both bulletins, but no intentions are listed for it, the parish website's Weekend Mass Schedule omits it (only 5:30 PM and 7:00 PM Italian), and Neocatechumenal Way Saturday Eucharists are normally celebrated by its communities rather than as an open parish Mass. Its place is not given. Leaning leave out as a likely closed group Mass (POLICY, What to extract).
slots.question: Add the Saturday 8:30 PM Neo-Catechumenate Liturgy as a public Mass?

sources.said: Join us every First Friday for Adoration from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM in Mother Cabrini Chapel.
Eucharistic Adoration 1st Friday: 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM Usually in the Parish Center's (Mother Cabrini Chapel)

slots.rationale: R6, R32: website only. Neither bulletin's week holds a first Friday (R11), so their silence says nothing. The site looks current (its third-Saturday Holy Hour for Life matches the November 21 entry in both bulletins). Doubt: where the Parish Center is; no address is given, though the bulletin lists a Chapel Sanctuary Lamp among the church's memorials, suggesting an on-site chapel. Leaning include at Holy Family; 'usually' hedges the room, not the time.
slots.question: Add First Friday Adoration, 2:00 to 7:00 PM, in the Mother Cabrini Chapel of the Parish Center?

slots.rationale: R6, R12, R32: the website gives the monthly pattern and end time; both bulletins' calendars print it on November 21, a third Saturday, at MCC (Mother Cabrini Chapel), while the website says usually in the main church. Same time either way; the doubt is only whether MCC is on Holy Family's grounds (see the First Friday question). Leaning include.
